# nexus piholezone

Verbs: get, add, remove

## Usage

```
nexus piholezone [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help   help for piholezone
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`nexus piholezone add`](nexus_piholezone_add.md) | Declare a DNS zone |
| [`nexus piholezone get`](nexus_piholezone_get.md) | List DNS zones, or with NAME, get a DNS zone |
| [`nexus piholezone remove`](nexus_piholezone_remove.md) | Remove a DNS zone |
